steps.content: Between the two of you is an unwinnable board of chess.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You trapped me here on purpose?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're not looking for an opponent at all. You're just stalling time... for "Serpent."

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I do want you to give her some more time, but I also want to see you myself.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I have high expectations for you. You're a special new recruit of the 9th Agency, Chief of the MBCC, and someone directly involved with BR-004.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Since you're so interested in me, why don't we talk about why you're helping the mastermind of the Sleepwalking crisis?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Why do you think?
Eirene continues to look at you with a smile. She's just having this roundabout conversation for fun. You look at the chessboard. Serpent is also in the black chess camp.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You never saw her as a friend. She's just one of your pawns.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You want to test out the power of Ambrosia, or rather, the power of the <color=#fb9259>new strain of Mania</color>. You're waiting to see how far Serpent can go. You won't allow me to obstruct her until she succeeds.
It seems that one can completely control and create a world in a lucid dream, while in reality, Sleepwalkers can also materialize their spiritual fluctuations by producing "contamination."
Eirene can already control the world of her dreams. If she can break through to the real world, she'd be able to use her consciousness to control reality through lucid dreaming.
Is this what she wants? The greedy capitalist, the careerist, the conqueror, or... the ruthless chessmaster?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I know how far she can go.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: What I want to know now is actually... how far you can go.
She smiles as always.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Let's have another round, Chief. As long as you beat me, I will grant you your wish and bring you to her.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I've told you the rules of the chess pieces without any reservation. Please entertain me thoroughly this time.
Her unsmiling eyes seem to say that she knows you can never win. You're well aware of this fact yourself.
But you're not going to throw in the towel, either. There may be other ways to "entertain" someone who is bored from always winning like her. You stare into her eyes and say...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Then let me subvert your chessboard.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You say the rules of the pieces come from their nature. Let's discuss the "human nature" on this chessboard, then. After all, I disagree with your rules with all my heart.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Like me, they're all living, breathing people, not pawns to be manipulated and discarded. Human nature cannot be summed up in a few words.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sure, Zoya uses violence to open the way. She harbors a lot of rage and paranoia, but in the end, she's still always fighting for others. It's only natural that she'd turn back for those she loves.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hamel sees the world differently from others, but that doesn't mean she's cold and indifferent. She just loves the world and those in it in her own way. The world is big enough to be her stage. She will find her audience.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hecate obeys orders well, but she's not a soulless robot. Despite her shortcomings, she's trying her best to understand this chaotic world. She has plenty of feelings, and will embrace many more possibilities in the future.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hella is not a weakling to be dismissed with contempt. You've never seen her fight with all her strength, so you can't imagine how strong she can be for those she cares about.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As for me... I'm not you. I'm neither a king nor a chessmaster. I'm one of them. I stand side by side with them on your chessboard. If I have to describe myself... then I'd say I'm their companion in this chess game of fate.
As you speak, your king moves forward on its own. The white chess pieces on your side vibrate gently, as if trying to break free from some kind of restraint and make an unexpected move.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: ...So what you're saying is, the chess pieces can break their own rules too?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes. An arrogant person like you can't see through anyone at all. The chess pieces will one day overturn your so-called rules and shatter your fictitious destiny.
